Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953
[Gazette of Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 21st August, 1984 ]
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953 (VI of 1953), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing ;
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Pakistan Air Force (Amendment.) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 6, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953
[Gazette of Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 21st August, 1984 ]
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953 (VI of 1953), for the purposes hereinafter

2. Amendment of section 6, Act VI of 1953.--In the Pakistan Air
Force Act, 1953 (VI of 1953), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in
section 4,-
(a) after
clause (xix), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely :-
"(xixa)
"Islamic law" means a law relating to the enforcement of Hudood ; and
(b) in clause
(xxxii),-
(i) after the
words "Pakistan Penal Code", the words " or in any Islamic
law" shall be inserted ; and
(ii) after the
word "Code" at the end, the words and commas "or, as the case
may be, that law" shall by added.

Substitution of section 48, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953
[Gazette of Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 21st August, 1984 ]
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953 (VI of 1953), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing ;
3. Substitution of section 48, Act VI of 1953.--In the said Act,
for section 48, the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"48.
Intoxication.-Any person subject to this Act who is found in a state of
intoxication shall, on conviction by court-martial- if he commits such offence
when on active service or on duty, be liable to suffer rigorous imprisonment
for a term which may extend to five years ; and
if be commits
such offence when not on active service or not on duty, be liable to suffer
rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years.".

Amendment of section 72, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984

Substitution of section 73, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953
[Gazette of Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 21st August, 1984 ]
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953 (VI of 1953), for the purposes hereinafter

6. Substitution of section 73, Act VI of 1953.--In the said Act,
for section 73, the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"73.
Punishments awardable by court-martial.-Punishments may be inflicted in
respect of offences committed by persons subject to this Act and convicted by
courts-martial according to the following scale, that is to say :-
(a) stoning to death
(b) death ;
(c) amputation
of hand, foot or both ;
(d)
imprisonment for life, which shall be rigorous imprisonment for a term not
exceeding twenty-five years ;
(e) long
imprisonment, which may be rigorous or simple for any term not exceeding
fourteen years ;
(f ) whipping not exceeding one hundred stripes ;
(g) short imprisonment,
which may be rigorous or simple for any term not exceeding two years ;
(h) dismissal
from the service ;
(i) detention
for a period not exceeding two years, in case of persons other than officers,
junior commissioned officers or warrant officers ;
(j )
reduction to the ranks or to a lower rank or to a lower grade, in the case of
non-commissioned officers ;
(k)
forfeiture of seniority of rank, in the case of officers, warrant officers and
non-commissioned officers ; and forfeiture of all or any part of their service
for the purpose of promotion, in the case of any of them whose promotion
depends upon length of service ;
(1)
forfeiture of service for the purpose of increased pay or any other prescribed
purpose ;
(m) severe
reprimand or reprimand, in the case of officers, warrant officers and
non-commissioned officers ;
(n) fine ;
(o)
forfeiture of pay and allowances for a period not exceeding three months for an
offence committed on active service ;
(p)
forfeiture, in the case of a person sentenced to dismissal from the service, of
the whole or any part of arrears of pay and allowances and other public money
due to him at the time of such dismissal ;
(q) stoppages
of pay and allowances to make good the whole or any part of the proved loss or
damage occasioned by the offence of which he is convicted
(r) any other
punishment provided for in any Islamic law Provided that-
(a) a person
shall not be sentenced to imprisonment for life or fine except in respect of an
offence of which he is convicted under section 71 ; and
(b) a person
shall not be sentenced to stoning to death, amputation of hand, foot or both or
whipping except in respect of an offence of which he is convicted under any
Islamic law.
Explanation.--While
computing a sentence under an Islamic law, "imprisonment for life"
shall have the same meaning as in such law."

Substitution of section 76, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953
[Gazette of Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 21st August, 1984 ]

the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953 (VI of 1953), for the purposes hereinafter

8. Substitution of section 76, Act VI of 1953.--In the said Act,
for section 76, the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"76.
Special provisions regarding sentences.-(1) Where a person subject to this Act
is sentenced to amputation of hand, foot or both, imprisonment for life,
imprisonment or whipping, the Court shall also sentence such person to be
dismissed from the service
Provided that
the sentence of dismissal from the service may not be combined with a sentence
of imprisonment not exceeding three months awarded to a person below the rank
of a warrant officer which is to be undergone in Air Force custody.".

Substitution of section 79, Act -VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953

Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953 (VI of 1953), for the purposes hereinafter

9. Substitution of section 79, Act -VI of 1953.- In the said Act,
for section 79, the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"79. Result
of certain punishments in the case of a non-commissioned officer.-A
non-commissioned officer sentenced by a court-martial to amputation of hand or
foot or both, imprisonment for life, imprisonment, dismissal from service,
detention or field punishment shall be deemed to be reduced to the ranks.".

Substitution of section 118, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953

10. Substitution of section 118, Act VI of 1953.--In the said Act,
for section 118, the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"118.
Powers of district court-martial.-A district court-martial shall have power to
try any person subject to this Act, except an officer, junior commissioned
officer or warrant officer, for any offence made punishable therein, and to
pass any sentence authorised by this Act other than a sentence of stoning to
death, death, amputation of hand, foot or both, imprisonment for a term
exceeding two years or whipping exceeding forty stripes.".

Amendment of section 119, Act VI of 1953

119, Act VI of 1953.--In the said Act, in section 119, for the full

"Provided
that, where the finding or sentence of the court-martial has not been confirmed

Provided further

Insertion of a new section 126-A, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

13. Insertion of a new section 126-A, Act VI of 1953.-In the said
Act, after section 126, the following new section shall be inserted, namely :-
"126-A.
Religion of confirming officer, president, judge advocate and members of
general, district or field general court-martial.-In the trial, by a
general, district or field general court-martial, of an accused who is a Muslim
for an offence punishable under an Islamic law, the confirming officer, the
president, the judge advocate and the members shall be Muslims.".

Insertion of new section 162-A, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953
[Gazette of Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 21st August, 1984 ]
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953 (VI of 1953), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing ;
16. Insertion of new section 162-A, Act VI of 1953.--In the said
Act, in Chapter XII, after section 162, the following new section shall be
added, namely :-
"162-A.
Court of Appeals.-(1) Any person to whom a court-martial has awarded a sentence
of hadd under an Islamic law may, within sixty days from the date of the
sentence, prefer an appeal against the finding and sentence of the
court-martial to a Court of Appeals consisting of the Chief of the Air Staff or
an officer, being a Muslim, designated by him in this behalf, hereinafter
referred to as the Court of Appeals.
(2) No
sentence awarded by a court-martial as hadd under an Islamic law shall be
executed unless it is confirmed by the Court of Appeals.
(3) The Court
of Appeals shall have power to-
(a) confirm
the finding or sentence or both ; or
(b) substitute
a valid finding or sentence for an invalid finding or sentence ; or
(c) call any
witness for the purpose of recording additional evidence in the presence of the
parties, who shall be afforded an opportunity to put any question to the
witness ; or
(d) annul the
proceedings of the court-martial on the ground that they are illegal or unjust
; or
(e) order
retrial of the accused by a fresh court.
(4) The
decision of the Court of Appeals shall be final and shall not be called in
question before any Court or other authority.".

Substitution of section 163, Act VI of 1953

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1984

17. Substitution of section 163, Act VI of 1953.--In the said Act,
for section 163 the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"163.
Form of sentence of stoning to death and death.-(1) In awarding a sentence
of stoning to death, a court-martial shall direct that the sentence shall be
executed in the manner provided for in the Offence of Zina (Enforce ment of
Hudood) Ordinance, 1979 (VII of 1979).
(2) In awarding
a sentence of death, a court-martial shall, in its discre tion, direct that the
offender shall suffer death by being hanged by the neck until he be dead, or
shall suffer death by being shot to death.
163-A. Form
of sentence, amputation of hand, foot or both.-In awarding a sentence of
amputation of hand, foot or both, a court-martial shall direct that the
sentence shall be executed in the manner provided for in the Offences Against
Property (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979 (V of 1979).
163B. Form of
sentence of whipping.--In awarding a sentence of whipping, a court-martial
shall direct that the sentence shall be executed in the manner provided for in
the Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979 (IX of
1979).".
